declaredParameters.rule: Concatenate the layers, then sort the polygons by extent, largest first. Nothing is merged, clipped or reprojected, and no polygon is dropped.
declaredParameters.extentRule: Extent is the sum over every ring of a polygon -- outer and interior alike -- of the absolute shoelace area of that ring, in square degrees. Holes are added, not subtracted.
declaredParameters.semantics: Extent is a sort key, not an area. It is unprojected and it counts holes positively, so it must never be read as a measurement of ground. summarize_combined_area and summarize_hull report areas; this widget does not, which is why it takes no UTM zone.
declaredParameters.identityRule: Two polygons sharing an identifier are refused, because once collected they cannot be told apart.

note: Concatenate the layers, compute each polygon’s extent by the declared rule, sort descending, and compare the resulting order of identifiers exactly.

integrity.note: SHA-256 of this fixture with the integrity field removed, serialised with object keys sorted, no whitespace and UTF-8. Not the file's bytes: the lab reads fixtures through a transport that re-serialises JSON.
